Quadratic domain and zero-radius limitation stated.

value.rationale: Sharp, nontrivial dimension-dependent phase boundary answers whether the natural undiscounted source oracle step is universally conditionally expected-descent safe. Full attainment in d2 and d>=3, golden-ratio conditioning transition and finite-difference smoothing floor provide actionable benchmark for selecting safety discount and understanding model noise. This is not merely a routine restatement of variance or Gaussian moments.
